name: review-link
title: A document under review carries a viewer link
outcome: Each time a workflow asks the user to approve a document, the user gets a checked link to that document's page in the viewer before the question.
done_when: review_link.py prints a deep link only after the page answers HTTP 200
The viewer renders the product, architecture, and program design documents at #/<work>/build/plan
verify_gate.py fails an APPROVED gate line dated on or after 2026-09-28 that carries no viewer link

min_work.derived_from: Five hand-offs call View mode and print the root URL only. build_index.py projects 03-program-design.md but not 01-product.md or 02-architecture.md, and the React viewer renders no page for a plan document. The build skill starts the viewer after the approval, not before it.
min_work.note: The user made the seven decisions in ADR-0032 in chat on 2026-09-28, and approved one ADR, one epic, and three slices, built without further questions. Design mode stages 2 to 7 did not run. This design carries a goal.json only.

epics.note: A viewer link for each document under review. Slice 1 adds review_link.py and a --route argument to View mode. Slice 2 projects the Gate 1 and Gate 2 documents and adds the plan page under the Build level. Slice 3 adds the Present for review procedure to every presentation point, and the link check to verify_gate.py.
